instruction: How to batch encrypt multiple files in a directory
output: for f in *.doc; do gpg --encrypt -r user@example.com "$f"; done

instruction: How to batch decrypt multiple files
output: for f in *.gpg; do gpg --decrypt "$f" > "${f%.gpg}"; done

instruction: How to batch sign all files in a directory
output: for f in *; do gpg --sign "$f"; done

instruction: How to verify all files with a matching .sig
output: for f in *; do [ -f "$f.sig" ] && gpg --verify "$f.sig" "$f"; done
